📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has declared the Assistant Professor (Government Degree College) Prelims Result 2026 for 5 out of 28 subjects on 07 August 2026. As per the official notice (No. 01/05/GDC(Pre.)/Confidential-3/2026-27), a total of 4,755 candidates have been provisionally declared successful for the Mains examination under Advt. No. A-7/E-1/2025. The result covers Chemistry, Economics, Geography, History, and Military Science (Defence Studies). Candidates can check their roll numbers and download the result PDF from the official website, uppsc.up.nic.in.

Download UPPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026 Notification PDF

UPPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026: Subject-Wise Details

The prelims exam for the Assistant Professor (GDC) recruitment was conducted for 28 subjects on 31 May 2026. The Commission has so far released results for 5 subjects. Registered, present, and qualified candidate figures for these subjects are given below.

The official notice states that in certain categories, the number of available candidates was less than the prescribed number because some candidates did not obtain the minimum qualifying standard fixed by the Commission.

How to Check and Download UPPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026

  1. Visit the official UPPSC website: uppsc.up.nic.in.
  2. Go to the "What's New" or "Result" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link related to Advt. No. A-7/E-1/2025 (Assistant Professor, Government Degree College).
  4. Select the subject-wise PDF (Chemistry, Economics, Geography, History, or Military Science).
  5. The result opens as a PDF containing roll numbers of provisionally qualified candidates.
  6. Use Ctrl+F (or the PDF search option) to locate your roll number.
  7. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

UPPSC Assistant Professor Selection Process

Based on the official notice, the selection process for this recruitment consists of the following stages:

  • Preliminary Examination - screening stage; result declared subject-wise.
  • Main Examination - candidates provisionally qualified in prelims will be eligible to apply online for the Mains exam. The Mains schedule and application process will be announced through a separate press notice.

Details of any interview or subsequent stage after the Mains exam are Not Available Officially in this notice.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • The result declared is provisional in nature.
  • The result of female candidates domiciled outside Uttar Pradesh is subject to the final order and judgment of the Hon'ble High Court in Special Appeal No. 475(D) of 2019.
  • The above result is also subject to the final order and judgment of the Hon'ble High Court in Special Appeal No. 233/2026.
  • Marks/cut-off scores of candidates will be made available on the Commission's website only after the final selection result is declared.
  • No representation regarding this result will be entertained under the Right to Information Act, 2005.
  • A separate press notice will be issued for the Mains exam schedule and the online application process for qualified candidates.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has officially confirmed that the KVS, NVS and EMRS Tier-II Recruitment Exam Result 2026 will be declared in phases starting mid-August 2026. The confirmation came through an official press note dated 7th August 2026 (Rectt. Notification/01/2025), issued to clarify media reports and rumours about the result. Descriptive answer books for 68 disciplines, totalling more than 2.1 lakh answer sheets, are currently undergoing physical evaluation, which CBSE says is at an advanced stage.

Download KVS NVS EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 Press Note

KVS NVS EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 - Quick Overview

Particular Details
Conducting Body Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), CTET Unit
Recruitment For Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)
Notification No. RECTT. NOTIFICATION/01/2025
Press Note Date 7 August 2026
Tier-II Exam Month March 2026 (official press note); reported as 27–31 March 2026 by aggregator sources - not stated in the official press note itself
Exam Pattern (Tier 2) Objective + Descriptive components
Descriptive Answer Books More than 2.1 lakh, across 68 disciplines
OMR Evaluation Status Completed
Descriptive Evaluation Status Ongoing, at an advanced stage
Result Release Window Phase-wise, commencing mid-August 2026
Exact Result Date Not Available Officially
Official Website ctet.nic.in, cbse.gov.in

What Did CBSE Say in the Official Press Note?

CBSE noted that certain media reports had been circulating regarding the declaration of Tier-II examination results for KVS, NVS and EMRS recruitment, conducted in March 2026. In response, the Board issued this press note to set out the actual status of evaluation and to caution candidates against relying on unverified information.

According to the press note, the Tier-II examination included both objective and descriptive sections. The display of provisional answer keys and OMR sheet images has been completed, and the evaluation of OMR (objective) sheets is finished. However, the descriptive answer books - more than 2.1 lakh of them, spanning 68 disciplines - are still being physically evaluated, and this process is at an advanced stage.

KVS NVS EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026: Expected Timeline

CBSE has stated that results will be declared in phases, commencing mid-August 2026, rather than as a single release date for all posts. This means candidates for different posts or disciplines may see their results announced on different dates within this phase-wise rollout.

  • Result release start: Mid-August 2026 (phase-wise)
  • Exact date/schedule per post or discipline: Not Available Officially
  • Result mode: Expected to be released via login on the official recruitment portal (based on the pattern followed for Tier-1 results; not explicitly restated in this press note)

Selection Process

Based on the recruitment structure referenced in official CBSE/CTET communications for this cycle, the selection process broadly follows these stages. Candidates should verify exact stage names/weightage for their specific post against the original recruitment notification.

  1. Tier 1 - Screening/objective examination
  2. Tier 2 - Objective and descriptive examination (result awaited, covered in this article)
  3. Skill Test / Interview - applicable as per post, conducted after Tier 2 result

How to Check KVS NVS EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 (Once Released)

The direct result link is not active yet. Once CBSE releases it, candidates are expected to be able to check their result using the following general process, based on how CBSE has released results for this recruitment cycle previously:

  1. Visit the official website - ctet.nic.in or cbse.gov.in.
  2. Look for the link related to "Recruitment of Various Teaching & Non-Teaching Posts in KVS, NVS and EMRS."
  3. Click on the Tier 2 Result/Scorecard link once activated.
  4. Log in using your Application Number and Date of Birth (or the credentials specified by CBSE).
  5. View and download your scorecard for future reference.

This direct link will be updated on official CBSE channels once activated; this article will be updated accordingly.

Important Instructions from CBSE

  • Rely only on information published through the official website.
  • Ignore unverified information or rumours regarding the Tier-II result circulating on social media or unofficial channels.
  • Results will be declared in phases - do not expect all posts/disciplines to be announced on the same date.

Candidates who appeared for the exam can now check their qualifying status and download the result PDF from the official portal. This page explains how to check the result, what the cut-off marks depend on, what documents you need next, and what to do if you cannot find your roll number.

Assam SLET Result 2026 Details

The Assam SLET Result 2026 confirms whether a candidate has qualified the eligibility test for Assistant Professor recruitment in colleges and universities across Assam and the North-Eastern region. The result PDF typically lists:

  • Roll numbers of qualified candidates
  • Subject-wise qualifying status
  • Category-wise cut-off marks

Qualification is based on the aggregate of Paper 1 (common paper) and Paper 2 (subject-specific paper). As per the standard SLET/NET framework, only a limited percentage of candidates historically around the top 6% category-wise are declared qualified, subject to also clearing the minimum qualifying marks for their category. Exact cut-off figures and the total number of qualified candidates for the 2026 cycle are not available in the official notification reviewed for this article; candidates should check the released PDF directly for category- and subject-wise cut-offs.

How to Check and Download Assam SLET Result 2026

  1. Open a browser and go to the official website: sletne.org.
  2. On the homepage, locate the Result Sheet or Results section.
  3. Click the link the result PDF will open on screen.
  4. Use Ctrl+F (or Cmd+F on Mac) and type your roll number to search the list quickly.
  5. If your roll number appears in the list, you are declared qualified.
  6. Download and save the PDF to your device for future reference.

No login, password, or application number is required to view or download the result PDF it is a direct public list published by the Commission.

Also Read: GSSSB Junior Pharmacist Revised Result 2026

Required Documents After Qualifying

If you are declared qualified, keep the following ready for the certificate and verification process (exact document checklist should be confirmed from the official notice, as it can vary by cycle):

  • Original and photocopy of mark sheets (graduation/post-graduation)
  • Category certificate, if applicable (SC/ST/OBC-MOBC/PwD/EWS)
  • Valid photo identity proof
  • SLET/SET admit card and result printout
  • Recent passport-size photographs

Important Instructions

  • Always access the result through the official domain sletne.org or sletneonline.co.in  avoid third-party links or social media screenshots, which can be outdated or inaccurate.
  • Qualifying the SLET does not guarantee a teaching job. Candidates must separately apply to Assistant Professor vacancies announced by universities or state recruitment bodies.
  • Keep your roll number, application number, and date of birth handy in case the portal requires them for verification.
  • If the result page is slow to load, this is often due to high traffic right after release retry after some time rather than assuming the link is broken.
  • Download and save a copy of the result PDF or scorecard immediately, since exam-body websites sometimes update or replace old notices.

What Qualifying Assam SLET 2026 Makes You Eligible For

  • Assistant Professor posts in universities across Assam and other North-Eastern states
  • Assistant Professor/teaching positions in government colleges under respective state education departments
  • Faculty roles in private universities and colleges that recognize SLET qualification
  • Research and academic roles in institutions that accept SLET/NET-equivalent eligibility

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

Union Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026: Direct PDF Download Link

Union Bank of India has announced the Apprentice Result 2026 for the recruitment conducted under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Candidates who appeared for the online written examination held on 07 June 2026 can use the direct link below to download the official result PDF and check their roll number in the state-wise provisional selection list.

Click Here to Download Union Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026 PDF

Union Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026: How to Check Your Roll Number

The result has been released as a state-wise PDF containing roll numbers of provisionally selected candidates. To check your name in the list:

  1. Open the official result PDF using the link given in the Important Links table below.
  2. Use Ctrl+F (or Command+F on Mac) to search the page.
  3. Locate your state name, then type your roll number to find it in the list.
  4. Save or take a screenshot of the page for future reference.

The roll numbers are grouped state-wise, covering candidates across Andhra Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Chandigarh, Chhattisgarh, Delhi, Goa, Gujarat, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Odisha, Puducherry, Punjab, Rajasthan, Sikkim, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Tripura, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and West Bengal.

Also Read: SBI CBO Final Result 2026 Out - Download PDF, Check Selected Candidates List

Union Bank of India Apprentice Selection Process

As per the result notice, final selection depends on successful completion of the following activities after the provisional result:

  1. Fulfilment of eligibility criteria/conditions as prescribed in the notification dated 28.04.2026, verified during Document Verification.
  2. Language Proficiency Test (for applicable candidates).
  3. Submission of Medical Fitness Certificate as mentioned in the notification dated 28.04.2026.

The Bank has clearly stated that selection is provisional and subject to production of all relevant documentary evidence supporting eligibility at the time of reporting.

Documents Required for Union Bank of India Apprentice Document Verification

Selected candidates must carry the following documents at the time of reporting:

  • 10 photographs (as uploaded on the NATS Portal)
  • Address Proof (Permanent and Communication)
  • PAN Card / Proof of PAN allotment
  • Aadhaar Card
  • All original certificates supporting eligibility (10th/Matriculation, 12th onwards) — both Degree and Marksheet must be produced
  • Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates) and Permanent PwBD Certificate (for candidates under the Disabled Category); OBC Certificate must carry the "Non-Creamy Layer" clause
  • EWS Certificate valid for FY 2025-26, if applicable
  • One self-attested photocopy set of all documents/certificates/IDs
  • Medical Fitness Certificate from a practicing registered general physician (minimum MBBS qualification)
  • Printout of the NATS Portal profile

Union Bank of India Apprentice Important Instructions

  • This result notice is treated as intimation to all candidates who appeared in the selection process; no separate communication will be sent to non-selected candidates.
  • A detailed communication with the venue and reporting date for document verification will be sent only to the registered email ID of selected candidates.
  • The Bank has stated that all care has been taken in compiling the result, but it reserves the right to rectify any error.
  • The Bank's decision on all matters relating to the selection process is final and binding.

The State Bank of India (SBI) has released the Circle Based Officer (CBO) Final Result 2026 for Advertisement No. CRPD/CBO/2025-26/18 on its official careers portal. SBI CBO Final Result 2026: What the PDF Says

The official final result notice, signed by the General Manager, states that the listed roll numbers belong to candidates provisionally selected as Circle Based Officers. The selection is explicitly subject to two conditions mentioned in the PDF:

  • Qualifying the Proficiency Test in Local Language(s)
  • Fulfilment of eligibility criteria and conditions as prescribed in Advertisement No. CRPD/CBO/2025-26/18 dated 29.01.2026

This means candidates whose roll numbers appear in the list have not yet received a final, unconditional offer - the Local Language Proficiency Test and document/eligibility verification are still pending. The official PDF does not state the total number of candidates selected; this figure is Not Available Officially at this time.

How to Download SBI CBO Final Result 2026 PDF

  1. Visit the official SBI careers portal at sbi.bank.in.
  2. Go to the "Careers" section and click "Current Openings."
  3. Look for "Recruitment of Circle Based Officer" against Advertisement No. CRPD/CBO/2025-26/18.
  4. Click the final result / list of provisionally selected candidates link.
  5. Use Ctrl+F (on desktop) to search your roll number or registration number in the PDF.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

What Happens After the SBI CBO Final Result?

Provisionally selected candidates should watch for further communication from SBI regarding:

  • Local Language Proficiency Test schedule (Not Yet Announced)
  • Document verification / biodata form submission
  • Joining formalities and posting circle confirmation

Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle of the State against which they applied and selected, and will not be entitled to an inter-circle transfer until promotion to SMGS-IV grade or completion of 12 years of service, whichever is later - as per the terms of the original advertisement.

Important Instructions

  • The result is provisional; it does not guarantee final appointment.
  • Candidates must retain a downloaded copy of the result PDF for future reference.
  • Any discrepancy in personal or roll number details should be reported to SBI through official channels only.
  • Candidates are advised to rely only on sbi.bank.in for official updates and to treat vacancy or date figures from third-party sites as indicative unless confirmed against the official PDF.

How to Check Your RBI Grade B DEPR Phase-I Result

This section explains the exact process for confirming your roll number in the official result document, so you know where to look and what to avoid.

The result has been published as a roll-number list within an official PDF on the RBI website. Rather than depending on third-party lists, always verify your own status directly.

  • Visit the official RBI website: www.rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities@RBI recruitment portal.

Shortlisted candidates will now move through the remaining stages of the SBI CBO recruitment process:

  • Interview
  • Language Proficiency Test
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination
  • Final Selection

The final merit list is prepared based on combined performance in the online examination and interview, with a reported weightage split of 75:25 (online test : interview), and the interview itself carries 50 marks.

SBI CBO Interview 2026: Date and Details

Since the interview is the immediate next step for shortlisted candidates, here's what is currently known about its schedule.

Reports indicate the SBI CBO interview round is scheduled for mid-July 2026, with different sources citing dates of 13 July and 14 July 2026. As this detail is subject to confirmation, candidates should wait for the official interview call letter on the SBI careers portal for their exact date, time, and venue rather than relying on any single unconfirmed date.

How Is the SBI CBO Merit Calculated?

Understanding the marking scheme helps candidates interpret their own performance realistically before the scorecard is released.

The SBI CBO written exam follows a standard negative marking pattern:

Final Marks = (Correct Answers × 1) - (Wrong Answers × 0.25)

A separate scorecard showing section-wise and overall marks is typically released by SBI after the result, accessible through candidate login credentials on the careers portal.

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Out - Check Provisional Allotment (CRP XIV)

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) released the IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 on 30th June 2026 for candidates who appeared in the CRP RRBs-XIV recruitment cycle. Candidates who were not allotted a bank in the main result can now log in to the official IBPS portal with their registration number and password/date of birth to check their provisional allotment status under the reserve list. The list currently covers 26 participating Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), and shortlisted candidates will also be informed through email and SMS on their registered contact details.

What Is the IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026?

This section explains the purpose of the reserve list and why IBPS issues it after the main selection round.

A reserve list is a backup panel that IBPS prepares after declaring the final result of the CRP RRBs-XIV exam. Once the primary list of selected candidates is allotted to participating banks, some vacancies remain unfilled because certain selected candidates do not join within the deadline, resign shortly after joining, or get rejected at the document verification stage. To ensure every sanctioned post is filled, IBPS draws candidates from the reserve panel, based on merit, category, and the number of vacancies still open, and provisionally allots them to a Regional Rural Bank for the Office Assistant/Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post.

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 - Quick Overview

This table summarizes the key details of the reserve list release for a quick reference before you check your status.

Particulars Details

Exam Name CRP RRBs-XIV (Clerk/Office Assistant)

List Type 1st Reserve List (Provisional Allotment)
Release Date 30th June 2026
Participating Banks Covered 26 RRBs
Mode of Allotment Online, login-based
Allotment Status Provisional (subject to verification)

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026: Direct Link to Check

This section gives you the official login link to view your provisional allotment status under the reserve list.

Candidates who appeared in the IBPS RRB Clerk Mains exam but did not feature in the original selection list can check their status through the official IBPS portal. Login requires your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Login Link (Active)

How to Check IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Online?

This section outlines the step-by-step process to view and download your reserve list allotment status.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.
  2. Click on the "CRP-CSA (Customer Service Associate)" tab on the homepage.
  3. Select "CRP-CRP XIV – Provisional Allotment under Reserve List."
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code and click on the Login button.
  6. View your allotment status and download the result for future reference.

How Will You Know If You're Selected?

This section explains how IBPS notifies candidates who get provisional allotment through the reserve list.

Candidates who are provisionally allotted a bank through the reserve list will receive an official communication via email and SMS on their registered email ID and mobile number. It is advisable to regularly check your registered contact details and the official IBPS portal so you don't miss any update.

What Happens After the Reserve List Allotment?

This section explains the next stages candidates must complete after receiving a provisional allotment.

Getting your name on the reserve list does not mean final selection it is a provisional allotment that becomes confirmed only after the bank completes verification. The typical process that follows includes:

  • Document Verification: Submission of original certificates and identity proofs for cross-checking.
  • Submission of Required Certificates: Educational, category, and other eligibility-related documents as specified by the allotted bank.
  • Medical Examination: Some banks may require a fitness check before final confirmation.
  • Joining Formalities: Completion of paperwork and reporting to the allotted branch.
  • Induction/Training Process: Orientation and training conducted by the bank before you begin regular duties.

Candidates should keep all original and photocopied documents ready in advance to avoid last-minute issues during verification.

Why Does IBPS Release a Reserve List?

This section explains the broader purpose behind the reserve list mechanism in IBPS recruitment.

A reserve list helps maintain smooth recruitment by ensuring sanctioned vacancies don't remain vacant. It benefits candidates who narrowly missed the initial cut-off by giving them another opportunity, while also helping banks manage manpower requirements efficiently across states and categories.

The interview call letter is a mandatory document for the SBI CBO Recruitment 2026 drive, which is being conducted to fill 2,050 vacancies for the Circle Based Officer post across various states and language zones. Without this call letter, candidates will not be permitted entry into the interview venue, so downloading and verifying it well in advance is essential.

SBI CBO 2026 Selection Process Explained

Understanding how your final selection is calculated helps you prepare strategically for the interview. This section explains the complete selection methodology for SBI CBO 2026.

The SBI Circle Based Officer recruitment follows a multi-stage selection process:

  1. Online Examination - The first screening stage testing candidates' aptitude and knowledge.
  2. Screening/Shortlisting - Candidates are shortlisted based on online exam performance for the interview stage.
  3. Interview - Worth 50 marks, assessing banking awareness, professional knowledge, and communication skills.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the regional/local language relevant to their applied state or circle.

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final selection isn't based on the interview alone it combines scores from multiple stages using a fixed weightage formula.

The final merit list for SBI CBO 2026 is prepared using combined weightage:

  • Online Examination: 75% weightage
  • Interview: 25% weightage

This means strong performance in the online exam significantly boosts your overall chances, but a good interview score remains essential for the final cutoff.

CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

The Central Bank of India has announced a total of 4,500 Apprentice vacancies for the financial year 2026-27, distributed across various states and union territories. Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh reportedly have the largest state-wise allocations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF on the bank's recruitment page for the exact state-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup, since detailed figures for every state were not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Candidates should check the official notification for the exact category-wise age relaxation applicable to them.

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Candidates should refer to the official Central Bank of India Apprentice notification PDF on centralbank.bank.in for accurate, category-wise fee details, since this cannot be reliably stated here.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

Phase 1 Exam Pattern - Objective Type (Qualifying)

Phase 1 is a 2-hour online objective exam carrying 200 marks across 200 questions. Since it is only qualifying, candidates must clear it to advance to Mains, but these marks do not count toward the final score.

Electronic devices including mobile phones, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and books are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall. The exam centre and date allotted on the call letter are final no requests for change of centre, date, or session will be entertained.

Punjab National Bank (PNB) has invited online applications for recruitment to 545 posts of Local Bank Officer (LBO) in Junior Management Grade Scale-I (JMGS-I). The vacancies are distributed across 17 states, and candidates can apply for only one state based on their eligibility and language proficiency. Online registration is open from 20.07.2026 to 16.08.2026. This article covers all details of the notification, including state-wise vacancies, eligibility, salary, selection process, and how to apply.

  • Extended Notification PDF: Click Here
  • Official Notification: Recruitment of Local Bank Officers in Punjab National Bank
  • Apply Online: Direct Link to Apply for PNB LBO Recruitment 2026

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026: Quick Overview

Particulars Details
Organization Punjab National Bank (PNB)
Post Name Local Bank Officer (LBO)
Post Code 01
Grade/Scale JMGS-I
Total Vacancies 545
Application Mode Online
Registration Opening Date 20.07.2026
Registration Closing Date 16.08.2026
Tentative Online Test Date August 2026 / September 2026
Selection Process Online Written Test + Screening + Language Proficiency Test + Interview
Official Website https://pnb.bank.in/

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

  • Opening Date for Online Registration: 20.07.2026
  • Closing Date for Online Registration: 09.08.2026
  • Extended Closing Date for Online Registration: 16.08.2026
  • Tentative Date of Online Test: August 2026 / September 2026

The exact date, centre, and venue of the Online Written Test will be communicated to candidates via Call Letter, downloadable from the Bank's website.

Also Read: Union Bank of India SO Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 395 Officer & Specialist Officer Posts

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026: State-wise Vacancy Details

A total of 545 vacancies are notified across 17 states/UTs. Candidates must apply for only one state and must be proficient in the mandatory local language specified for that state. The Bank has clarified that the number of vacancies, including reserved category vacancies, is provisional and subject to change.

Refer to the official notification PDF for the exact category-wise PwBD split for each state.

Key Points on Vacancy Distribution

  • Candidates belonging to reserved categories for which no vacancy has been announced in a state may apply against Unreserved (UR) vacancies of that state, if they meet UR eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates can apply for a vacancy in one state only. Applying against one state makes a candidate ineligible to apply against any other state.
  • The merit list will be drawn state-wise and category-wise.
  • Selected candidates will be posted within the selected state until completion of nine (9) years of service or promotion to SMG Scale IV, whichever is earlier.
  • Prior experience will not be considered for seniority in service.
  • PwBD reservation is on a horizontal basis; selected PwBD candidates will be placed in their applicable category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR) and posted within the state applied for, at locations identified suitable by the Bank.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality/Citizenship

An applicant must be:

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A subject of Bhutan, or
  • A Tibetan Refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India.

Candidates in the last four categories must have a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India before the date of this notification, and must also be proficient in the local language of the state applied for.

Candidates who have completed their graduation in any discipline can also explore more Bank Officer Jobs and Graduate Government Jobs available across India.

Age and Educational Qualification

Post Scale Age (Years) Educational Qualification
Local Bank Officer (LBO) JMGS-I Min: 20, Max: 30 Graduate in any discipline from a University/Institution recognized/approved by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies

The candidate must possess a valid Mark-sheet/Degree Certificate confirming graduate status on the day of registration, and must indicate the percentage of marks obtained in Graduation while registering online.

Local Language Requirement

Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, and speaking the specified local language of the state for which they are applying (as listed in the state-wise vacancy table). A Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) will be conducted by an external agency for candidates who have not studied the local language as a subject in Class 10 or Class 12.

Post-Qualification Experience

  • Candidates must possess a minimum of one year of post-qualification work experience in Clerical/Officer Cadre in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or Regional Rural Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the RBI Act, 1934.
  • One advance increment is payable for each completed prior year of service as an Officer in Scheduled Commercial Banks (subject to a maximum of 2 increments), if the job profile matches that of a Scale-I Generalist Officer of PNB.
  • Candidates from subsidiaries of Scheduled Commercial Banks (Officer cadre) are eligible for only one advance increment under the same condition.
  • Proof of prior experience must be submitted in the prescribed format, duly certified by the previous employer.
  • Experience in other financial institutions will not be considered if the job profile does not substantially match that of a PNB Scale-I Generalist Officer.
  • No prior service/experience will be considered for seniority purposes.

Cut-off Dates for Eligibility

  • Age: Reckoned as on 01.07.2026
  • Mandatory Experience: Reckoned as on the closing date for online registration, i.e., 09.08.2026
  • Educational Qualification: Reckoned as on the closing date for online registration, i.e., 09.08.2026
  • The result of the qualifying examination must have been declared on or before 09.08.2026.
  • Candidates must indicate the percentage obtained in Graduation to the nearest two decimals; CGPA/OGPA must be converted to percentage as per the university's official conversion formula. A fraction of percentage will be ignored (e.g., 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%).

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Age Relaxation

Sr. Category Age Relaxation
(i) Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe 05 Years
(ii) Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 03 Years
(iii) Persons with Benchmark Disability 10 Years
(iv) Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers (ECOs/SSCOs with min. 5 years military service) 05 Years
(v) Persons affected by 1984 riots 05 Years

The maximum age limit is applicable to Unreserved (UR) and EWS category candidates. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) is allowed cumulatively with only one of the remaining categories under (iii) to (v) above. Candidates seeking relaxation must submit the necessary certificates at the time of Interview and at any subsequent stage as required by the Bank.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026: Salary and Perquisites

Selected candidates will draw pay in the scale of Rs. 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 under JMGS-I. In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates will be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), HRA/Leased Accommodation, Leave Fare Concession, Medical Insurance, Retirement Benefits, and other perquisites as per Bank rules.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Category Fee Amount (per candidate)
SC/ST/PwBD category candidates Rs. 50/- + GST @18% = Rs. 59/- (only postage charges)
All others (UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS) Rs. 1000/- + GST @18% = Rs. 1180/-

Payment is accepted only through online mode (Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI). Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and cannot be reserved for any other examination.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for the post of Local Bank Officer shall be conducted in four phases. The Bank reserves the right to decide whether all or any of these modes shall be adopted:

  1. Online Written Test
  2. Screening
  3. Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT), if applicable
  4. Personal Interview

Online Written Test Structure

Name of the Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Sectional Duration (Minutes)
Reasoning & Computer Aptitude 25 25 35
Data Analysis & Interpretation 25 25 35
English Language 25 25 25
Quantitative Aptitude 25 25 35
General/Economy/Banking Awareness 50 50 50
  • There is negative marking: one-fourth of the marks assigned to each question is deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS category, 35% for Reserved category, in each section. The Bank reserves the right to revise this at its discretion.

Screening

The online application and submitted documents of written-test-qualified candidates will be scrutinized to confirm eligibility before the Language Proficiency Test/Interview. Candidates found ineligible or with incorrect/false documents at any stage will be rejected from further participation.

Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

  • Candidates who have not studied the applied-for state's local language as a subject in Class 10 or 12 must appear for the LLPT.
  • The LLPT is qualifying in nature; candidates must secure the Bank-prescribed minimum qualifying marks to be considered for final selection.
  • Candidates who fail to qualify the LLPT are treated as ineligible for final selection, irrespective of performance in other stages.
  • Candidates who indicate they studied the local language in Class 10/12 are exempt from LLPT, subject to submission of valid documentary evidence at verification.

Personal Interview

  • All candidates shortlisted after qualifying the Online Written Test will be called for interview.
  • The Personal Interview carries 50 marks.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 45% (22.50 marks) for SC/ST candidates; 50% (25 marks) for other candidates.
  • Candidates who fail to secure minimum qualifying marks in the interview will be disqualified.

Final Selection

  • Final selection is based on combined performance in the Online Written Test and Personal Interview, subject to qualifying the LLPT (where applicable).
  • Candidates who fail the LLPT are ineligible for final selection even if they qualify in the written test and interview.
  • The merit list is prepared state-wise and category-wise.
  • In case of a tie, the older candidate (by date of birth) is placed higher in the merit list.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

The following original documents, along with a self-attested photocopy, must be produced at the time of interview:

  • Printout of the valid Interview Call Letter
  • Valid system-generated printout of the Online Application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X Certificate with DOB)
  • Photo Identity Proof and Address Proof (Officially Valid Documents)
  • Semester-wise/Year-wise Mark sheets and final Degree/Diploma Certificate, with proof of result declaration on or before 09.08.2026
  • Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates)
  • Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates, in the prescribed format, matching the Central Government list letter by letter)
  • Disability Certificate (for PwBD candidates, issued by the District Medical Board)
  • Discharge Certificate/Service Book and Pension Payment Order (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • No Objection Certificate (for candidates serving in Government/PSU/Financial Institutions)
  • Experience Certificate in the prescribed format, along with appointment letter, salary slips, relieving letter, etc.
  • Any other relevant documents in support of eligibility

How to Apply for PNB LBO Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB website: https://pnb.bank.in/, under Recruitment/Career.
  2. Click "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter basic personal details to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent via Email/SMS).
  3. Re-login using the Provisional Registration Number and Password to complete the application form.
  4. Upload scanned images of photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per prescribed specifications (see below).
  5. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to verify details before clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" - no changes are allowed after this step.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee through the online payment gateway (Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, IMPS, Wallets, or UPI).
  7. On successful payment, an e-receipt will be generated.
  8. Take a printout of the submitted application form and e-receipt for personal record; do not send these to the Bank.

Applications are accepted online only, from 20.07.2026 to 16.08.2026, through https://pnb.bank.in/. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Document Upload Specifications

Document Dimensions File Size Format
Photograph 4.5cm × 3.5cm (200 x 230 pixels preferred) 20KB – 50KB JPG/JPEG
Signature 140 x 60 pixels preferred 10KB – 20KB JPG/JPEG
Left Hand Thumb Impression 3cm x 3cm (240 x 240 pixels, 200 DPI) 20KB – 50KB JPG/JPEG
Hand-written Declaration 10cm x 5cm (800 x 400 pixels, 200 DPI) 50KB – 100KB JPG/JPEG
Caste/Disability Certificate - Not exceeding 500KB PDF
Educational Qualification Documents - Not exceeding 500KB PDF
Work Experience Documents - Not exceeding 500KB PDF

The photograph must be a recent passport-style colour picture with a light-coloured background; caps, hats, and dark glasses are not acceptable (religious headwear is allowed if it doesn't cover the face). The signature and hand-written declaration must NOT be in capital letters. Candidates must also capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone during registration.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions

  • Candidates who have earlier worked in PNB or its merged/amalgamated entities and were discharged for reasons other than VRS/Resignation are not eligible to apply.
  • Candidates against whom there are adverse reports regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude are not eligible to apply.
  • There is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in direct recruitment to Officer Cadre; however, age relaxation applies as per Government guidelines.
  • Selected candidates must execute an Indemnity Bond to serve the Bank for at least 3 years, or pay Rs. 2,00,000/- if they leave before completing 3 years of service.
  • Candidates must maintain a minimum CIBIL score of 680 or above at the time of joining. This is not a pre-condition to apply, and candidates with no bank account are not required to produce CIBIL status.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Eligibility

Who Can Apply

This drive is open only to candidates belonging to the SC, ST, and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) categories against backlog vacancies. General/UR and EWS category candidates are not eligible to apply under this specific advertisement.

Educational Qualification (As on 31.12.2026)

  • Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government.
  • Candidates with an Integrated Dual Degree (IDD) certificate must ensure the date of passing the IDD is on or before 31.12.2026.
  • Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed by 31.12.2026, if provisionally selected.
  • Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education (or equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate), after completing at least 15 years of service, are also eligible.

Who Is NOT Eligible

  • Candidates currently working in SBI's Clerical cadre.
  • Candidates previously employed in SBI who resigned while in the clerical cadre.
  • Candidates against whom there is an adverse report regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude.
  • OBC candidates falling under the "Creamy Layer."

PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities)

The post is identified as suitable for candidates with Blindness/Low Vision, Deafness/Hard of Hearing, specified locomotor disabilities (One/Both Arms or Legs, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Muscular Dystrophy, Spinal Deformity/Injury without associated neurological dysfunction), Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness, and Multiple Disabilities involving the above. PwBD candidates apply under their respective parent category (SC/ST/OBC) as there is no horizontal PwBD reservation in this drive; a valid Disability Certificate on the prescribed format, dated on or before the last date of registration, is required to avail concessions such as scribe facility and compensatory time.

Ex-Servicemen (XS)

Candidates must meet the definition of Ex-Serviceman as per Government of India, Ministry of Home Affairs Notification No. 36034/5/85/Estt(SCT) dated 27th October 1986 (as amended). Disabled Ex-Servicemen, dependents of servicemen killed in action, and Territorial Army Personnel (w.e.f. 15.11.1986) are covered under specific conditions detailed in the official notification, including submission of the applicable Proforma (A, B, C, or D) as relevant to their service status.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility

Eligibility is specific to each discipline code, as detailed below. In all cases, the qualification must be from a recognised University/Institute pursued as a full-time regular course; qualifications acquired through part-time, correspondence, or distance learning are not eligible.

Discipline Code Post Qualification
101 Technician Apprentice (Mechanical) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, minimum 50% aggregate (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% (SC/ST/PwBD for reserved positions), from an AICTE/UGC-recognised institute/university
102 Technician Apprentice (Electrical) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical Engineering, same marks criteria as above
103 Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering, same marks criteria as above
104 Technician Apprentice (Civil) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Civil Engineering, same marks criteria as above
105 Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, same marks criteria as above
106 Technician Apprentice (Electronics) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering, same marks criteria as above
107 Trade Apprentice (Fitter) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
108 Trade Apprentice (Electrician) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electrician) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
109 Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
110 Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
111 Trade Apprentice (Machinist) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Machinist) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
112 Graduate Apprentice (BBA/BA/B.Com/B.Sc.) Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline, minimum 50% aggregate (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% (SC/ST/PwBD for reserved positions), from an AICTE/UGC-recognised institute/university
113 Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator (Fresher) Class 12th pass (below graduate)
114 Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) Class 12th pass (below graduate) plus a Skill Certificate in 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' (training of less than one year) issued by a body recognised under the National Skill Qualifications Framework or another Central Government-recognised authority

Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Where CGPA/OGPA/Letter Grade is awarded, the equivalent aggregate percentage must be indicated in the online application as per the norms of the concerned Board/University/Institute, with a supporting certificate furnished at document verification.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second must be in a different trade, with a minimum one-year gap between the two (subject to conditions specified in the notification for terminated contracts).
  • Candidates applying under NATS or NAPS who have completed five years in the relevant discipline (as on 31.08.2026) after acquiring the prescribed qualification are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as B.E., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB, or equivalent (completed on or before joining) are NOT eligible.
  • Diploma or Vocational Certificate holders with one year or more of job experience after acquiring the qualification are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates whose apprenticeship contract has already been approved by BOAT on the NATS portal cannot create a second apprenticeship contract, even if the earlier one is later terminated.
  • Candidates can apply for ONLY ONE discipline code; applying for more than one will lead to summary rejection of all applications.

Category Age Limit (as on 31.08.2026)
General/UR/EWS Minimum 18 years, Maximum 24 years
OBC-NCL Up to 27 years (3-year relaxation, for posts reserved for them)
SC/ST Up to 29 years (5-year relaxation, for posts reserved for them)
PwBD (General) Up to 10 years' relaxation over the base limit
PwBD (SC/ST) Up to 15 years' relaxation over the base limit
PwBD (OBC-NCL) Up to 13 years' relaxation over the base limit

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Stipend

The stipend payable to apprentices is governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961, the Apprentices Rules, 1992, and applicable amendments/guidelines. In addition to the statutory stipend, IOCL (MD), NR will pay ₹2,500 per month towards miscellaneous expenses. For Graduate and Technician Apprentices, a portion of the stipend is disbursed directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the apprentice's Aadhaar-seeded bank account by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT). Trade Apprentices (NAPS apprentices) receive their full stipend directly from IOCL (MD), NR. These arrangements are subject to change as per government/BOAT/NAPS guidelines issued from time to time. A specific fixed monthly stipend amount is not stated in the official notification.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Application Start Date 07 August 2026, 10:00 AM
Application Last Date (NAPS/NATS portal + Microsoft Office Form) 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM
Document Verification for Shortlisted Candidates Intimated on registered email ID (specific date not fixed)
Cutoff/Reckoning Date (Age & Qualification) 31 August 2026

Any change in dates will be communicated only through the official IOCL website, so candidates are advised to check it regularly.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  1. Online Application: Candidates registered on the NAPS/NATS portal and applying against the notification are considered for selection. There is no written test or interview.
  2. Merit List: Prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the prescribed qualification for the respective post. Ties are resolved first by earlier date of birth, and then by higher marks in matriculation if the date of birth is also the same.
  3. Preference: Given to candidates applying for apprenticeship training for the first time.
  4. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification.
  5. Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test: Candidates must be adjudged medically fit as per IOCL's pre-engagement medical standards.
  6. Offer of Engagement: Issued to candidates who successfully clear document verification and the medical fitness test. Up to ₹3,000 is reimbursed towards expenses incurred for pre-engagement medical tests/investigations, on production of receipts.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

The following original documents, along with self-attested copies, must be furnished at document verification:

  • Matriculation (Class X) mark sheet/certificate issued by the Board of Secondary Education - the only acceptable proof of date of birth.
  • Latest caste certificate (for reserved category candidates) in the Government-prescribed proforma, issued by a competent authority.
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed Government of India format, issued on or after 01.09.2025 (not more than 12 months old as on 31.08.2026), for candidates claiming OBC-NCL reservation.
  • Certificate from the institute confirming the candidate pursued the course through regular mode, with the year of passing.
  • Semester-wise/year-wise mark sheets of ITI (NCVT/SCVT)/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering, as applicable.
  • Final ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering certificate issued by the respective Board/Authority/Institute.
  • Copy of the first page of the bank passbook of the Aadhaar-seeded account, Aadhaar card, PAN card, and a cancelled cheque leaf.
  • Pre-engagement medical fitness certificate.

How to Apply for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Register as a Graduate/Technician/Trade Apprentice on the applicable portal for your state:
    • Trade Apprentice (ITI): NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator: NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice (Diploma): NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in
    • Graduate Apprentice: NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in
  2. Ensure your profile (personal details, educational details, category, aggregate percentage) is complete and correct before applying; corrections must be made through the NAPS/NATS office.
  3. Log in to the respective NATS/NAPS portal and apply for the opportunity using IOCL (MD)-Northern Region's Establishment ID: NATS – NDLSDC000005; NAPS – E05200700003.
  4. After applying on the NAPS/NATS portal, also submit your details, preferred state, and three preferred locations via the Microsoft Office Form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/pw7D2cUK7c
  5. Both the NAPS/NATS application and the Microsoft Office Form must be completed by 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Only one Microsoft Form response is allowed - multiple submissions will not be entertained.
  6. Apply for only ONE discipline code; applying for more than one will lead to rejection of the application.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates must have a valid, active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number on NAPS/NATS, and 100% completion of their profile.
  • Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least 1 year, as all communication regarding document verification/engagement will be sent only via email/SMS.
  • Candidates must possess a PAN card, an Aadhaar card, and an active bank account with a cheque book (same account as updated on the NATS portal), seeded to Aadhaar and enabled for DBT, along with an updated APAAR ID and e-KYC verification on the NATS portal.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats will be considered only if they meet the standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • Candidates registered with a Local/State Employment Exchange/Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD must apply only through the NAPS/NATS portal.
  • The apprenticeship period is 12 months for all disciplines. On completion, IOCL has no obligation to offer regular employment, and apprentices cannot claim employment rights on the grounds of completing the apprenticeship. Ex-apprentices get an equal opportunity to apply for future openings like any other candidate.
  • Candidature is provisional and subject to verification; any false/incorrect/suppressed information detected at any stage - even after engagement - can lead to cancellation or termination.
  • Engagement is subject to being declared medically fit as per Corporation requirements and all relevant rules/policies/guidelines.
  • The decision of the management is final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, selection, and cancellation of the process; filling of seats is entirely at the discretion of management, and no claim will arise if seats remain unfilled.
  • Incomplete applications, applications in any other mode, or those received after the last date will be treated as rejected. Canvassing of any kind will disqualify the candidate.

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released Advertisement No. 10/2026, inviting online applications for recruitment by selection to 7 posts across various central government ministries and the Union Territory of Ladakh administration, with a total of 34 vacancies. Posts include Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil and Electronics), Assistant Director (Engineering), Superintendent Translation (Hindi Branch), Research Officer, Horticulture Development Officer, and Soil Conservation Assistant. Eligible candidates can apply online through the Commission's website upsconline.nic.in/ora from 08-08-2026. The last date to apply is 28-08-2026 (for posts other than those under UT of Ladakh) and 04-09-2026 (for posts under UT of Ladakh). Job locations vary by post and include Noida, New Delhi, Kolkata, and Union Territory of Ladakh.

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi has released Indicative Advertisement No. 10/2026 for direct recruitment by selection to 7 different posts with 34 vacancies. UPSC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS male candidates: Rs. 25/- payable via Debit/Credit Card, UPI, or Internet Banking

  • Fee once paid is not refundable and cannot be carried forward to another examination or selection
  • Applications submitted without the prescribed fee (where applicable) will be summarily rejected

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection is made by interview, or by Recruitment Test (RT)/Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) followed by interview, depending on the post; the notification does not specify which mode applies to each individual post above. Category-wise minimum level of suitability in the interview (out of 100 marks) is UR-50, OBC-45, and SC/ST/PwBD-40. Where an RT is held, candidates must meet the minimum qualifying level at both the RT and interview stages.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

  • Matriculation/10th Standard certificate or mark sheet showing date of birth
  • Degree/Diploma certificate as proof of educational qualification (or provisional certificate with mark sheets)
  • Order/letter for any equivalent qualification claimed
  • Experience certificate(s) in prescribed proforma from Head(s) of Organisation(s)/Department(s)
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, plus OBC non-creamy-layer declaration where applicable
  • Certificate of Disability in prescribed proforma for PwBD candidates
  • Documents for name change, if applicable
  • Certificates for age relaxation claims (Ex-Servicemen, Central/UT Government employees, etc.)
  • Domicile Certificate of Ladakh (for Horticulture Development Officer and Soil Conservation Assistant posts)

How to Apply for UPSC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the UPSC Online Recruitment Application portal at upsconline.nic.in/ora
  2. Complete Account creation, Universal Registration, and the Common Application Form (CAF) - these are common to all UPSC recruitments
  3. Fill the post/vacancy-specific fourth module for the desired post within the application period
  4. Upload photograph, live photo capture, and signature as per the specified instructions
  5. Upload supporting documents/certificates for all claims made (date of birth, category, qualification, experience, disability, etc.)
  6. Submit the application before the closing date; applications cannot be withdrawn or edited after submission
  7. Take a printout of the finally submitted online application for future reference

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card as the ID document for verification
  • Correspondence, including interview schedules, will be sent only to the registered e-mail ID
  • Mobile phones and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall
  • Face authentication is mandatory for candidates at the examination venue/interview hall
  • Furnishing false particulars or suppressing material information can lead to disqualification or debarment
  • Candidates already in regular government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department before applying

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Overview

Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL) is conducting this Special Drive to engage Apprentice Trainees under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, through NATS. Here is a quick overview of the KRCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026.

Particulars Details
Organization Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL), a Government of India Undertaking
Notification No. CO/APPR/2026/01, dated 7 August 2026
Scheme National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
Posts BE/Diploma Apprentices in Civil, Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering; General Stream Graduate Apprentices
Total Vacancies 134
Mode of Engagement NATS portal registration followed by Document Verification (no separate online application form specified)
Document Verification Dates 24, 25, 27 and 28 August 2026 (post-wise)
Venue Executives Club, Konkan Rail Vihar, Sector-40, Opp. Seawoods Railway Station (West), Navi Mumbai-400706
Duration of Training 1 year

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Important Dates

Document Verification is scheduled post-wise as follows. Registration on the day of Document Verification is only between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM.

The notification does not specify a separate NATS portal registration deadline; candidates must have a valid, approved NATS ID at the time of Document Verification.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Vacancy Details

A total of 134 Apprentice Trainee slots are available across nine post categories under Medical Category B1 (engineering posts) and C1 (General Stream Graduates).

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria

KRCL Apprentice Qualification

Candidates must have passed out during 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 (within the last 5 years from the date of passing the qualifying exam and date of joining training). Qualification requirements by category:

  • Category I – Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics & Power Engineering (or a combination of basic Electrical sub-streams) for Electrical Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering (or a combination of these basic streams) for Electronics Engineering; or Mechanical/Industrial/Automobile/Production Engineering for Mechanical Engineering - from an AICTE-recognized university.
  • Category II – Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Diploma in Civil Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics & Power Engineering (or a combination of basic streams) for Electrical; or Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering (or a combination) for Electronics; or Mechanical/Industrial/Automobile/Production Engineering for Mechanical - from a University or Institution recognized by the Central/State Govt. Technical Education Board or University.
  • Category III – Graduate Apprentices (General Stream): Bachelor of Arts / Science / Commerce / Business Administration / Management Science / Journalism and Mass Communication / Business Studies from a UGC or Central/State Govt./Technical Education Board recognized University or Institute.

No additional weightage is given for a higher qualification than the minimum prescribed. Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act, 1973 in any Government/PSU/Private Industrial Organization are not eligible.

Also Read: RRB JE 04/2026 Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 4098 Junior Engineer Posts

KRCL Apprentice Age Limit

Age Limit: 18 to 25 years as on 1 January 2026 (date of birth between 1 January 2001 and 1 January 2008).

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST 5 years
OBC-NCL 3 years

Age relaxation is subject to submission of the required documents at the time of Document Verification.

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

KRCL Apprentice Physical Fitness

Candidates must meet the minimum physical fitness standards prescribed in the notification and must bring a medical certificate, in the prescribed Apprentice Act, 1961 format, certified by a Government Doctor not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of the Central/State Medical Services, at the time of Document Verification. Final medical fitness is certified by KRCL's Medical Authority, and the cost of the medical examination is borne by the candidate.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Stipend

Stipend is paid through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism, combining the Government of India's DBT share and KRCL's establishment share.

Category Government DBT Share (per month) KRCL Establishment Share (per month)
Graduate Apprentices Rs. 6,150 Rs. 6,150
Technician (Diploma) Apprentices Rs. 5,450 Rs. 5,450

Candidates must have a bank account in their own name and a PAN card to receive the stipend, and must retain the same Aadhaar-linked bank account until training completion. Candidates must also make their own lodging and boarding arrangements during training.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Application/ Processing Fee

The exact processing/examination fee amount is not specified in the provided notification. The notification does describe fee-waiver provisions: candidates from Economically Weaker Sections can submit an income certificate issued by the Tehsildar to seek a fee waiver, and Minority community candidates can submit a self-declaration affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper to claim a fee waiver, in the prescribed formats.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process

  • For all categories, marks obtained across all years/semesters are summed to arrive at an aggregate percentage, and a merit list is prepared accordingly. No rounding off is done, and no weightage is given to any particular semester or year.
  • In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate is preferred; if dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed matriculation earlier is selected.
  • Land loser candidates (as defined in the notification, whose land was acquired for the Konkan Railway Project) are given first preference in selection.
  • Candidates from the districts under KRCL's jurisdiction - Raigad, Ratnagiri and Sindhudurg (Maharashtra), North Goa and South Goa (Goa), and Uttara Kannada, Udupi and Dakshina Kannada (Karnataka) - are given second preference.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Required Documents

Candidates must bring the following original documents (as applicable) to Document Verification, along with self-attested photocopies:

  • Semester/year-wise mark sheets along with Degree/Diploma certificate
  • 10th Pass/Matriculation certificate as proof of date of birth
  • Land loser certificate and Tehsildar certificate (for land loser candidates), with supporting RTC land documents and proof of relationship
  • Legal heir and death certificate of the land loser, where applicable
  • Domicile certificate
  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) in the Central Government format, and OBC-NCL certificate issued by the Tehsildar, to claim reservation
  • Income and Asset Certificate for EWS category candidates
  • Income certificate from the Tehsildar and Minority Community declaration affidavit, for fee waiver where applicable
  • Gazette notification or legal document for any formal change of name
  • Two attested passport-size photographs
  • Aadhaar card and PAN card
  • A valid, approved NATS ID

How to Apply for KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27

The notification does not describe a separate online application form with a fee-payment step; engagement is through NATS portal registration followed by walk-in Document Verification. To participate in KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27:

  1. Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal and obtain a valid, approved NATS ID.
  2. Check your post-wise Document Verification date from the schedule (24, 25, 27 or 28 August 2026).
  3. Prepare original documents along with self-attested photocopies, as listed in the Required Documents section.
  4. Arrive at the venue - Executives Club, Konkan Rail Vihar, Sector-40, Opp. Seawoods Railway Station (West), Navi Mumbai-400706 - and complete registration between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM on your scheduled date.
  5. Attend Document Verification, along with the prescribed medical certificate.

Selection is cancelled if a candidate fails to produce the required original testimonials at Document Verification, or if any discrepancy is noticed at any stage.

KRCL Apprentice Trainee Important Instructions

  • Candidates should enter their name, father's name, and date of birth exactly as recorded in their Matriculation/SSC/High School certificate.
  • Candidates must maintain an active personal email ID for the entire duration of enrolment, as KRCL will send all communications only through email; requests to change the registered mobile number or email will not be entertained.
  • Furnishing wrong, fake, or false certificates can lead to termination of the training contract.
  • Training in KRCL does not confer any right to future employment or absorption in KRCL after completion.
  • The duration of training is 1 year, and candidates can be deployed anywhere within KRCL's jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing or pressuring through any source will disqualify the candidature without prior intimation.
  • The decision of the KRCL administration on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and mode of selection is final.

Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF), a Navratna Government of India undertaking, has released the RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 notification (Advertisement No. 16022026) for 94 Management Trainee posts across 14 disciplines, including Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, Fire, Information Technology, Finance, Marketing and Rajbhasha. Online registration for RCF Management Trainee Vacancy 2026 opens on 8 August 2026 and closes on 24 August 2026.

RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification Out

Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd), a Navratna Government of India undertaking, has released the RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification (Advertisement No. 16022026) for the recruitment of 94 Management Trainee posts across 14 disciplines. Eligible candidates can apply online for disciplines including Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, Fire, Information Technology, Finance, Marketing, Rajbhasha and other streams.

The RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 online application process will start on 08 August 2026 and continue till 24 August 2026. Candidates selected through the Online Test and Personal Interview process will undergo one-year traineeship and may be absorbed in the E1 grade after successful completion.

  • RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
  • Direct Link to Apply Online

RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Overview

RCF is inviting applications from eligible engineering graduates, postgraduates and professionally qualified candidates for one-year traineeship positions leading to absorption in the E1 grade. Candidates can apply online only through the official RCF website. Here is a quick summary of the RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 before the detailed sections below.

RCF Management Trainee Vacancy 2026 Details

RCF Management Trainee Vacancy 2026 covers 94 posts across 14 disciplines. The table below gives the post code, discipline, total vacancies, and category-wise reservation breakup (UR, SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS, PwBD).
