RCF Management Trainee Eligibility Criteria

RCF Management Trainee Eligibility depends on the discipline applied for. Only Indian citizens meeting both the educational qualification and age limit as on 01.02.2026 can apply. Below is a discipline-wise summary; the official notification carries the complete list of accepted degree combinations (regular 4-year degree, 3-year degree after diploma, or dual/integrated degree) for each post.

RCF Management Trainee Qualification (Discipline-wise)

Discipline Core Qualification Requirement Minimum Percentage
Chemical Regular full-time BE/B.Tech in Chemical Engineering / Chemical Technology / Petrochemical Engineering / Petrochemical Technology (or equivalent 3-year degree after diploma, or dual/integrated degree) from a UGC/AICTE-recognised institution 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Boiler BE/B.Tech in Chemical / Petrochemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Electrical, plus a valid Boiler Operation Engineer's Certificate (BOE) or Boiler Proficiency Certificate from a Statutory Authority 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Mechanical BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (or 3-year degree after diploma, or dual/integrated degree) from UGC/AICTE-approved institutions 60%
Electrical BE/B.Tech in Electrical Engineering / Electrical and Power Engineering / Electrical Power Engineering 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Instrumentation BE/B.Tech in Instrumentation Engineering / Instrumentation Technology / Instrumentation and Control Engineering 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Materials BE/B.Tech in Chemical, Petrochemical, Chemical Technology, Mechanical, Electrical, Electrical and Power, Instrumentation, Instrumentation Technology, or Instrumentation and Control Engineering (this post is reserved for ST/PwBD-Low Vision category as per the notification) 55% for ST category
Civil BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering or allied disciplines (Civil and Infrastructure Engineering, Construction Engineering, Construction Technology and Management, etc.) 60%
Fire BE/B.Tech in Fire or Fire & Safety discipline from UGC/AICTE-approved institutions 60%
CC Lab Ph.D. in Chemistry (preferred) OR BE/B.Tech in Chemical Engineering / Petrochemical Engineering / Chemical Technology No percentage criteria for Ph.D.; 60% for engineering graduates
Industrial Engineering BE/B.Tech in Industrial Engineering, OR BE/B.Tech in any discipline plus a 2-year PG degree/diploma in Industrial Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Management, or Industrial Engineering and Operations Research 60% in the qualifying degree
Information Technology BE/B.Tech in Information Technology / Computer Science / Computer Technology / Computer Engineering 60% (55% for SC)
Rajbhasha Master's degree in Hindi with English as a compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination, or Master's degree in English with Hindi as compulsory/elective, or Master's degree in another subject with Hindi and English combinations as specified in the notification 60% in final year of post-graduation
Finance CA/CMA, OR a full-time graduation degree in Commerce/Accounting/Finance (B.Com, BMS, BAF, BBA) plus a 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDM with specialisation in Finance. M.Com alone is not considered. No percentage criteria for CA/CMA; 60% for the postgraduate route (55% for SC/ST)
Marketing Full-time Science/Engineering/Agriculture graduate plus a 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDM with specialisation in Marketing or Agri-Business Management/Agriculture 60% (55% for SC/ST)

For all disciplines, wherever CGPA/OGPA/SGPA or a letter grade is awarded, candidates must convert it to an equivalent percentage as per the norms of their university or institute and mention this in the application. Candidates in the final year of graduation or post-graduation are not eligible to apply.

RCF Management Trainee Age Limit

The upper age limit is calculated as on 01.02.2026 and varies by category. The general pattern followed across most disciplines is given below; a few posts (such as Boiler, Materials, CC Lab, Rajbhasha, Civil, and Fire) have narrower category-specific age limits because reservation is not notified for every category in those posts. Candidates should refer to the specific post-code table in the official notification for the exact age limit applicable to their category and discipline.

Category Upper Age Limit (general pattern, most disciplines)
UR / EWS 27 years
OBC (NCL) 30 years
SC / ST 32 years
PwBD (UR/EWS) Up to 37 years, where notified for the post
PwBD (SC/ST) Up to 42 years, where notified for the post
PwBD (OBC-NCL) Up to 40 years, where notified for the post

An additional age relaxation of 5 years is available to children/family members of victims of the 1984 riots, across all categories. Age relaxation for SC/ST and OBC(NCL) candidates applying against reserved posts is up to 5 years and 3 years respectively; PwBD candidates get further relaxation as specified in the notification.

RCF Management Trainee Salary

Selected candidates undergo a one-year training period and are paid a lump sum stipend of ₹60,000 per month during this period. Free hostel accommodation on a sharing basis is provided at Trombay/Thal, along with medical facility at the RCF Hospital.

On successful completion of training, trainees are absorbed in the E1 Grade with a pay scale of ₹40,000–₹140,000. The minimum total monthly gross emoluments (Basic Pay + VDA at 51.80% + Perks at 34% + HRA at 30% and other allowances) work out to approximately ₹86,320. Management Trainees posted outside Trombay and Thal (such as at Marketing Area Offices) additionally receive a fixed allowance of ₹5,000 per month towards boarding, lodging, and local travel, plus TA/DA on tours.

A bond amount of ₹2 lakh must be deposited by the Management Trainee at the time of joining as a fixed deposit with lien marked to RCF Ltd, for a period of 4 years including the one-year training period. On absorption, employees also become eligible for company accommodation (subject to availability), Performance Related Pay, free medical facility for self and dependents, gratuity, contributory provident fund, accident insurance, and pension scheme as per company rules.

RCF Management Trainee Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General / OBC (NCL) / EWS ₹1,000 plus applicable bank charges and GST
SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / PwBD / Female candidates Exempted - no application fee

Fees can be paid online only, through internet banking, debit card, or credit card. Once paid, the application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances, so candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before making the payment.

RCF Management Trainee Selection Process

The RCF Management Trainee Selection Process consists of an Online Test followed by a Personal Interview.

Online Test

  • Computer-based objective test of 90 minutes, with 100 questions in total.
  • 50 questions (2 marks each) are from the course curriculum of the relevant discipline/qualifying degree.
  • 50 questions (1 mark each) cover General English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and General Knowledge/Awareness.
  • There is negative marking for wrong answers.
  • The test is conducted in Hindi (Rajbhasha) and English, at centres in Bhopal, Delhi/Delhi NCR, Lucknow, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/MMR region, and Nagpur.

Personal Interview

  • Based on online test performance and document verification, eligible candidates are provisionally called for interview in a ratio of approximately 1:7 (7 candidates per post).
  • Candidates must score a minimum average of 50% in the interview to qualify.
  • Outstation candidates are reimbursed III-tier AC train/bus fare for both the online test and interview, as per the terms in the notification.

Final Merit List

Parameter Weightage
Online Test 80%
Personal Interview 20%

Separate category-wise and discipline-wise merit lists are prepared. Candidates with nil or negative marks in the online test are not eligible for interview. Final selection is also subject to a pre-employment medical examination and document verification.

RCF Management Trainee Required Documents

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) as per specified scan requirements
  • Signature scanned on white paper with black ink
  • Left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink
  • Handwritten declaration (in the candidate's own handwriting, in English) as per the format given in the notification
  • Valid photo identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Aadhaar, etc. - Ration Card and Learner's Licence are not accepted)
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma, where applicable (SC/ST/OBC-NCL)
  • Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates, issued on or after 1 April 2025
  • Disability certificate for PwBD candidates, as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates currently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets relevant to the applied discipline

How to Apply for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RCF website, www.rcfltd.com, and click on "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Fill in the application form, using "Save and Next" to complete it in stages if required.
  4. Upload the scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specifications in the notification.
  5. Upload other required documents (single combined PDF file per category, maximum 500 KB) as listed in the advertisement.
  6. Preview and validate all details before clicking "Complete Registration".
  7. Pay the application fee online, where applicable, and take a printout of the e-receipt.
  8. Click "Submit" to complete the RCF Management Trainee Apply Online process.

RCF Management Trainee Apply Online: Important Instructions

  • Only online applications are accepted; physical application forms will not be considered.
  • Details submitted in the online application form, including correspondence address, email address, mobile number, category, post applied for, and test city, cannot be changed after submission.
  • Candidates must possess a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active throughout the recruitment process, as all communication will be sent electronically.
  • Candidates already employed in Central/State Government, Quasi-Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.
  • RCF reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, or modify the recruitment process, and to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, without prior notice.
  • Any corrigendum or update will be published only on www.rcfltd.com under "HR → Recruitment"; no separate press advertisement will be issued.

IOB Local Bank Officer Selection Process 2026-27

Selection is made through an Online Examination, followed by a Language Proficiency Test (LPT) for candidates who have not studied the applied state's local language in Std. X or Std. XII, and a Personal Interview.

Language Proficiency Test (LPT)

Candidates shortlisted for the Personal Interview who have not studied the applied state's local language in Std. X or Std. XII must qualify an LPT before the interview. Candidates who fail the LPT will not proceed further in the selection process.

Personal Interview

The Personal Interview carries 100 marks. The minimum qualifying marks are 45% for reserved category candidates and 50% for unreserved candidates.

Final Selection

The weightage of Online Examination and Personal Interview is in the ratio of 80:20. The minimum aggregate score (Online Exam + Interview) required is 30% for reserved categories and 35% for unreserved category candidates. The final merit list is prepared state-wise and category-wise.

The online examination will be conducted at various centres across India, including Chennai, Madurai, Coimbatore, Tiruchirappalli in Tamil Nadu; Bengaluru, Hubli-Dharwad, Mysuru in Karnataka; Mumbai/Thane/Navi Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur in Maharashtra; and Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar, Surat, Rajkot in Gujarat, among other centres nationwide. SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection for all 10 posts across the three advertisements is based on Shortlisting and Interview:

  • Shortlisting: Merely meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to an interview call. The shortlisting committee decides the parameters, and the Bank's decision on which candidates to call is final.
  • Interview: Carries 100 marks; qualifying marks are decided by the Bank.
  • Merit List: Prepared in descending order of interview scores; candidates tied at the cut-off are ranked by age (older candidates ranked higher).

BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for BoB Recruitment 2026 may comprise Application Scrutiny, an Online Test, a Psychometric Test, and/or a Group Discussion and Personal Interview, as decided by the Bank for each post.

  • Online Test (if conducted): Tentative structure includes Reasoning (25 questions/25 marks), English Language (25 questions/25 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions/25 marks), and Professional Knowledge (75 questions/150 marks), for a total of 150 questions/225 marks in 150 minutes. Reasoning, English Language, and Quantitative Aptitude sections are qualifying in nature; only Professional Knowledge marks count toward the final result. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
  • Psychometric Test/Personal Interview (PI): Conducted to assess personality, communication, problem-solving ability, efficiency, and willingness to work in any part of the country. The minimum qualifying marks for PI are 60% for General & EWS category and 55% for other reserved categories.
  • Final Selection: Based on combined scores from the Online Test and/or PI, subject to vacancies available under the respective category.

  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (birth certificate or SSLC/Std. X marksheet)
  • Photo identity proof (PAN Card/Passport/Driving Licence/Voter's Card/Bank Passbook with photo/Aadhaar card, etc.)

  • No Objection Certificate from current employer (for candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Bank)
  • Documents supporting work experience (appointment letter, salary slips, relieving letter, etc.)
  • Any other relevant document in support of eligibility

How to Apply for BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website at www.bankofbaroda.bank.in and go to the Career section → Current Opportunities.
  2. Register online using a valid personal email ID and mobile number, which must be kept active till completion of the recruitment process.
  3. Fill in the online application form carefully, upload a scanned photograph, signature, and supporting documents such as Date of Birth proof, qualification certificates, experience letters, and category certificates, as per the specifications given in the notification.
  4. Verify all details before submitting, since no changes are permitted after clicking the Submit button.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  6. On successful payment, download and retain a printout of the e-receipt and the completed application form for future reference.

BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply, as selected candidates will be posted at the Bank's absolute discretion.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of 12 months.
  • Candidates selected for JMG/S-I posts must execute a service bond to serve for a minimum of 3 years or pay an amount equivalent to three months' gross salary (not exceeding Rs. 2 lakh) if they leave before completing three years.
  • Candidates selected for MMG/S-II, MMG/S-III, and SMG/S-IV posts must execute a similar service bond, with the payable amount not exceeding Rs. 3 lakh.
  • Change of category is not permitted at any stage after registration of the online application.
  • There is no reservation for Ex-servicemen in the Officers' Cadre.
  • The number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, is provisional and may vary according to the Bank's actual requirement.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate; in case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.

KEA VAO Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates must satisfy both the nationality and educational qualification requirements laid down in the notification before applying.

  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • A living man having more than one wife, and a woman who has married such a man, are not eligible for appointment without prior Government permission.
  • Candidates must be mentally and physically fit to discharge the duties of the post.

Educational Qualification

Candidates applying for the post of Village Accountant must have passed PUC (Pre-University Course, equivalent to Class 12) or a qualification recognized as equivalent to PUC by the Government of Karnataka. Equivalent qualifications include:

  • Class 12 examination conducted by CBSE or ICSE boards.
  • Class 12 examination conducted by other State Government pre-university education boards.
  • Advanced vocational courses/NSDC-affiliated courses conducted through the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS).
  • Candidates with a two-year ITI (Industrial Training Institute) course, provided they have also passed one language subject and one general subject at a pre-degree level examination, are treated as equivalent to PUC only for these specified fields.
  • Candidates who completed a three-year diploma from a technical education department institution before 2015 are also required to have cleared the Kannada-language subject through an SSLC-level examination.

Candidates possessing a qualification higher than PUC are also eligible to apply, provided they meet the other eligibility conditions.

Additional age relaxation beyond the above limits is permitted for specific categories, as detailed in the notification, including:

  • Persons already serving in Karnataka Government, local body, State/Central statutory or PSU service - relaxation equal to years of service or 10 years, whichever is less.
  • Ex-servicemen - relaxation equal to the length of service rendered, plus 3 years.
  • National Cadet Corps (NCC) full-time supervisors - relaxation equal to years of service.
  • Persons employed as Grama Samuha Parishilakaru under the rural self-employment scheme - relaxation equal to years of service.
  • Special Chetana (persons with disabilities) candidates - 10 years relaxation.
  • Persons employed by the Government of India census organization in Karnataka - relaxation equal to years of service or 5 years, whichever is less.
  • Widows who have not remarried, or women legally divorced and not remarried - 10 years relaxation, subject to proof.
  • Retrenched employees who repaid retrenchment compensation as per the Karnataka Retrenched Employees Act/1957 rules - 10 years relaxation, subject to proof.
  • Transgender/third-gender candidates - 1% horizontal reservation with corresponding age relaxation as per the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019.

Candidates seeking any of the above relaxations must produce the original supporting certificate at the time of document verification.

KEA VAO Salary 2026

Selected candidates for the post of Village Accountant will be placed on the state government pay scale below and will be entitled to benefits under the National Pension Scheme (NPS). All appointees will serve a probation period of 2 years from the date of regular appointment.

  • Pay Scale: ₹34,100 - 800 - 35,700 - 900 - 39,300 - 1,000 - 43,300 - 1,125 - 47,800 - 1,250 - 52,800 - 1,375 - 58,300 - 1,500 - 64,300 - 1,650 - 67,600

KEA VAO Application Fee 2026

The application fee must be paid online only, at the time of form submission. Fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

Category Application Fee

SC / ST / Category-1 / Ex-Servicemen / Third Gender ₹500 (₹250 application fee + ₹250 processing fee)
Special Chetana (PwBD) candidates ₹250 (processing fee only)

KEA VAO Selection Process 2026

Selection to the post of Village Accountant is made purely through a competitive written examination; the notification does not mention any separate interview round. The process is as follows:

  • Candidates will appear for a competitive written examination conducted in Offline-OMR mode.
  • A minimum of 35% marks in the competitive exam is required for eligibility; candidates scoring below this will be disqualified.
  • Candidates opting for the Kannada language exam exemption must have passed Kannada as first or second language up to SSLC level, or must clear a compulsory qualifying Kannada language test (150 marks, minimum 50 marks required to qualify). This paper is not counted toward merit ranking.
  • District-wise merit lists / marks lists will be prepared and forwarded by KEA to the respective District Magistrates for appointment, which is made at the district level.

KEA VAO Exam Pattern 2026

The written examination consists of two papers, each carrying 100 marks and lasting 2 hours, with negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer.

Paper Subject Total Questions Total Marks Duration
Paper 1 General Knowledge (current affairs, general science, Indian Constitution, Indian and Karnataka history and geography, Panchayat Raj and rural cooperative institutions, and Karnataka regional issues and development) 100 100 2 hours
Paper 2 General Kannada, General English, and Computer Knowledge 100 100 2 hours

Each question offers 4 answer options with only one correct answer. A minimum qualifying score of 35% is required in the competitive exam.

How to Apply for KEA VAO Recruitment 2026

Applicants must apply strictly online through the KEA CET portal by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the official KEA website: cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea
  2. Click on the application link for VAO Recruitment 2026 applicable to your cadre (General/RPC or Kalyana-Karnataka).
  3. Register with your basic details and generate login credentials.
  4. Fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and category details, selecting only one district of preference.
  5. Upload a recent passport-size photograph (JPEG format, 50KB-200KB) and signature (JPEG format, 50KB-70KB) as per the specified format.
  6. Verify all entered details carefully, as no correction is allowed after submission.
  7. Pay the applicable application fee online and complete the submission.
  8. Download and retain a printout of the submitted application and fee payment receipt for future reference.

KEA VAO Important Instructions

  • Applications will be accepted online only; offline or postal applications will not be considered.
  • Candidates can apply to only one district; applications submitted for more than one district will not be accepted.
  • Original documents must be produced at the time of document verification for eligibility, age, and category claims. Failure to appear with valid original documents on the specified date will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates are responsible for reading all eligibility instructions before applying; incomplete or incorrect information may result in rejection of candidature at any stage.
  • Impersonation, submission of forged documents, or use of unfair means during the exam or interview process will lead to disqualification and possible criminal/disciplinary action.
  • Aadhaar Card is mandatory for application submission.

CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL), Bengaluru, a unit under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), Ministry of Science and Technology, has released Advertisement No. 13/2026/PS (published 05.08.2026) inviting applications for engagement of Project Staff - Project Assistant (PA-I, PA-II), Project Associate (PAT-I, PAT-I NET/GATE, PAT-II, PAT-II NET/GATE), Senior PAT, and Principal PAT - to work on CSIR, externally-funded, and other projects at CSIR-NAL. CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026 has no online application - candidates must attend the Walk-in-Interview in person between 10 and 25 August 2026, on the specific date assigned to the post and specialization they are applying for.

Quick answers: CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL), Bengaluru is recruiting Project Staff across roughly 14 post/specialization combinations spanning Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics, Chemistry, Metallurgy, and Computer Science disciplines. Adding the position-wise numbers gives approximately 89 posts (computed; the notification does not state one combined total). Only Indian Nationals who already hold the required degree/diploma (no result-awaited candidates) can apply, with age limit 35 years for all posts. There is no apply-online step and no application fee - candidates must walk in with the prescribed application form and documents. Walk-in-Interviews run from 10 August 2026 to 25 August 2026, at CSIR-NAL (RAB Meeting Complex), Kodihalli, Bengaluru – 560017, with registration from 9:00 AM to 9:45 AM on each interview date.

CSIR-NAL Eligibility Criteria & Qualification 2026

CSIR-NAL Selection Process 2026

Selection is based on performance in the interview, or any other criteria adopted by the Selection Committee. If a large number of candidates appear, the Selection/Screening Committee has the discretion to shortlist candidates through a written exam or any other criteria it deems fit before the interview. A panel of suitable candidates is drawn up after the selection process, valid for a maximum of one year; empanelment does not automatically guarantee engagement, and utilization depends on the number of positions available across projects during that period.

How to Apply for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026 (Walk-in-Interview Process)

CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026 has no apply-online option, and applications sent by post, speed post, or e-mail are explicitly not accepted.

  1. Download the prescribed Application Form for Walk-in-Interview (Advt. No. 13/2026/PS) from the CSIR-NAL website and fill it completely.
  2. Report in person at CSIR-NAL (RAB Meeting Complex, National Aerospace Laboratories), Adjacent to SBI NAL Branch, Kodihalli, Bengaluru – 560017, between 9:00 AM and 9:45 AM on the date fixed for the post/specialization you are applying for.
  3. Bring a copy of your Aadhaar Card or another Government-issued photo ID, the duly filled application form, a latest passport-size photograph, and original certificates along with one set of photocopies (including Caste Certificate, if applicable, in the proper format).
  4. Candidates wishing to apply for more than one position must apply separately for each position.
  5. Be prepared to return the next day if your interview is not completed on the scheduled date for any reason.

No TA/DA is paid for attending the Walk-in-Interview. Candidates already working in CSIR-NAL or any other CSIR lab must bring a "No Objection Certificate" from their Project Leader/HOD at the time of interview.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Indian Army has invited online applications from unmarried male and female law graduates for the Short Service Commission (JAG) Course under the JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course (April 2027). This recruitment offers 10 combined vacancies in the Judge Advocate General (JAG) Branch of the Indian Army. Eligible candidates must hold an LLB degree and a valid CLAT PG 2026 score to apply. The online application process for Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course recruitment 2026 is open from 17 July 2026 to 17 August 2026 on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.

Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course Notification PDF

Candidates should download and read the official notification carefully before applying. Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course Notification PDF 

Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course: Quick Overview

Particulars Details
Organization Indian Army
Post Name Short Service Commission (JAG) Course
Total Vacancies 10 (combined for men and women)
Application Mode Online
Category Defence Recruitment / Central Government
Job Location Officers Training Academy, Chennai (training); SSB at Prayagraj, Bhopal, Bengaluru, Jalandhar
Official Website www.joinindianarmy.nic.in

Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course Important Dates

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 17 Jul 2026, 1500 hrs
Online Application Last Date 17 Aug 2026, 1500 hrs
Shortlisting for SSB (based on CLAT PG score) Second week of September 2026
SSB Centre/Date Selection Window Two weeks in September 2026
Likely SSB Duration and Dates Up to five days, November/December 2026
Training Start Date April 2027

Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course Vacancy Details

Post Branch Total Vacancies
Short Service Commission (JAG) Course Judge Advocate General Branch 10 (combined for men and women)

The Indian Army notifies combined vacancies for men and women based on the operational and administrative requirements of the Force, and the final selection and merit depend on the notified vacancies for this particular course.

Also Read: Indian Army SSC (Tech)-68 Men Recruitment 2026: Notification, Eligibility, Dates, Salary

Eligibility Criteria for Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course

Nationality

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, and the East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, and Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India (a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India is required for these categories, except Gorkha subjects of Nepal).

Marital Status

Open only to unmarried male and unmarried female law graduates.

Educational Qualification

  • Minimum 55% aggregate marks in LLB Degree (three years professional course after graduation, or five years after 10+2 examination).
  • CLAT PG 2026 Score (conducted in December 2025) is mandatory for all candidates, including LLM-qualified and LLM-appearing candidates. No other CLAT PG exam score will be accepted.
  • Candidates must be eligible for registration as an advocate with the Bar Council of India/State.
  • The LLB degree must be from a College/University recognized by the Bar Council of India.
  • All candidates applying for JAG Entry must get their CLAT PG 2026 result verified at the Selection Centre before the SSB is conducted - failure to do so makes the candidate ineligible for SSB, with no representation accepted.

Candidates holding a law degree can also explore more LLB Government Jobs and Law Graduate Government Jobs available across India.

Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course Age Limit

Particulars Details
Age Limit 21 to 27 years as on 01 Jan 2027
Date of Birth Range Not earlier than 02 Jan 2000 and not later than 01 Jan 2006 (both dates inclusive)

The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate (or equivalent) on the date of application submission will be treated as final; no subsequent request for change will be considered.

Indian Army JAG Salary and Pay Scale

  • Stipend during training at OTA, Chennai: ₹56,100 per month.
  • Rank after training: Lieutenant.
  • Pay Level on commissioning: Level 10, ₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500.
  • Military Service Pay (MSP): ₹15,500 per month (Lieutenant to Brigadier).
  • Approximate CTC on commissioning: ₹17–18 lakh per annum.
  • Additional allowances (as applicable and subject to eligibility conditions): Dearness Allowance, Para Allowance, Field Area Allowances, Dress Allowance, Transport Allowance, Children Education Allowance, Hostel Subsidy, among others specified in the notification.

Application Fee

Not specified in the notification.

Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course Selection Process

  1. Application submission and shortlisting (based on CLAT PG 2026 score and vacancy-to-call-up ratio).
  2. Selection of SSB Centre and Date (first-come-first-served, once selected cannot be changed by the candidate).
  3. SSB Interview (two-stage selection at Prayagraj, Bhopal, Bengaluru, or Jalandhar) - duration up to five days. Candidates failing Stage-I are returned the same day.
  4. Medical Examination for candidates recommended after Stage-II.
  5. Merit List preparation based on SSB marks.
  6. Joining Letter for Pre-Commission Training at OTA, Chennai, subject to eligibility and vacancy.

Qualifying the SSB interview alone does not confirm final selection - final selection depends on the merit list and availability of vacancies.

Documents Required for SSB Interview

  • Signed printout of the online application with self-attested photograph.
  • Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate (or equivalent) and mark sheet.
  • 12th Class Certificate and Mark Sheet.
  • Graduation Degree/Provisional Degree (for three-year LLB after graduation).
  • LLB Degree/Provisional Degree from a recognized university.
  • Mark sheets of all years/semesters.
  • Registration with Bar Council of India/State, or a certificate confirming the LLB course is recognized by the Bar Council of India.
  • University certificate on the CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula (if applicable).
  • CLAT PG 2026 Score Card (conducted in December 2025).

DigiLocker certificates will not be accepted in place of original certificates. All original documents must be carried for verification at the SSB; originals are returned after verification.

Also Read: IAF Agniveervayu Musician Recruitment 2026 (Intake 01/2027) - Apply Online, Eligibility, Dates

How to Apply for Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course

  1. Visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in and click on 'Officer Entry Application/Login'.
  2. Click 'Registration' (not required if already registered on the website).
  3. Fill the online registration form after reading the instructions carefully.
  4. After registration, click 'Apply Online' under the Dashboard.
  5. On the 'Officer Selection – Eligibility' page, click 'Apply' against Short Service Commission JAG Entry Course.
  6. Fill in personal information, communication details, education details, and previous SSB details (if any) under the 'Application Form' page.
  7. Review the summary of information, then click 'Submit' only after confirming all details are correct.
  8. Take two printouts of the application (with roll number) 30 minutes after the online application closes on the last day.

Important Instructions

  • No changes can be made to the online application after it closes; no representation on this will be entertained.
  • CGPA/Grades must be converted to marks as per the university's formula before filling in the application.
  • The candidate's name, parents' names, and date of birth in the profile and application must match the Matriculation/Secondary School certificate exactly.
  • Only one online application per candidate is allowed; multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates serving in the Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer in writing and carry a countersigned application to the SSB.
  • Requests to change the SSB interview date or centre will not be entertained.
  • Candidates must report within 7 days of their candidature reporting date, or their candidature will be cancelled.
  • Candidates who marry after the date of application, or during training, will lose eligibility or be withdrawn from training.
  • In case of any discrepancy between the English and Hindi versions of the notification, the English version shall prevail.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Eligibility Criteria for CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates planning to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Bharti 2026 must meet all eligibility conditions set by CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd. The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and no upper age limit is mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must hold a valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized testing and certifying agency.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have one of the following qualifications to be eligible for the CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026:

Qualification Option Details
Option 1 12th Pass (Intermediate / Senior Secondary)
Option 2 Matriculation + 2 Years ITI
Option 3 Matriculation + 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma

Age Limit

The minimum age to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator Vacancy 2026 is 18 years. No maximum age or age relaxation details are mentioned in the official notification.

Mandatory Certificate Requirement

Every applicant must possess an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar services. Additionally, candidates must have basic computer skills. Candidates who do not yet hold this certificate can appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the link: https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action

Who is NOT Eligible

As per the official notification, VLEs (Village Level Entrepreneurs) are not eligible to apply for the Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District post under this CSC recruitment drive.

Salary / Remuneration - CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator 2026

Selected candidates under the CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026 will be paid as per the state government's prescribed wage structure. The remuneration for all selected Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator candidates will be the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower. The exact figure will vary from state to state based on the applicable minimum wage notification of Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.

How to Obtain the Aadhaar Supervisor Certificate Before Applying

Candidates who do not yet hold the mandatory Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate need to complete two steps before they are eligible to apply for CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra jobs. First, they must apply for and pass the Aadhaar Supervisor exam; second, they must complete the LMS certification. Both processes are managed through official UIDAI platforms.

  1. Visit the Aadhaar Supervisor exam portal at https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action and submit your exam application.
  2. An authorization request will be sent to the State Team. Once approved, you will be permitted to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam.
  3. After your LMS ID and Password are created and approved, appear for the Aadhaar LMS Certification through the portal at https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in
  4. Once certified, proceed to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor district post on the CSC Job Portal.

How to Apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026

The CSC Aadhaar Operator Apply Online 2026 process is conducted entirely through the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in. Candidates must ensure they have their Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate ready before beginning the application. The last date to apply is 20 August 2026, and no offline applications are accepted under this recruitment.

  1. Visit the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in.
  2. Navigate to the relevant job post for your state - Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.
  3. Click on the "Apply Now" button on the job post page.
  4. Fill in the online application form with your personal, educational, and certification details.
  5. Upload the required documents including your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate.
  6. Submit the application form before 20 August 2026.

CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Apply Online 2026

Eligible candidates can submit their online applications for the CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026 through the official CSC Job Portal. The apply online facility is available for all four states - Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra. Ensure your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate is valid and issued by a UIDAI-authorized agency before clicking Apply Now. The online application window closes on 20 August 2026.

Common Mistakes to Avoid in CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Many candidates make avoidable errors while applying for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Vacancy 2026 that can lead to rejection of their application. The points below are based on common patterns seen in similar contractual government recruitment drives and are not derived from the official notification.

  1. Applying without a valid UIDAI certificate: The Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized agency is a mandatory requirement. Applying without it will result in disqualification.
  2. VLEs applying despite ineligibility: VLEs are explicitly barred from applying. Submitting an application as a VLE wastes your time and will be rejected at the verification stage.
  3. Applying for the wrong district: Each vacancy is district-specific. Ensure you apply for the correct district as per your location and preference.
  4. Incomplete LMS Certification: Candidates sometimes have the Supervisor exam cleared but not the LMS Certification. Both are required before applying.
  5. Submitting incorrect documents: Upload clear, legible scans of your educational certificates and Aadhaar Operator certificate. Blurry or mismatched documents can cause rejection.
  6. Missing the last date: The portal closes applications on 20 August 2026. Do not wait until the last day — technical issues near the deadline are common.
  7. Confusing CSC e-Governance with state government jobs: This is a contractual, not permanent government post. Ensure you understand the terms of engagement before applying.

Eligibility Criteria (Post-Wise Summary)

1. Agricultural Engineer

Qualification: Degree in Agricultural Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university, with 2 years’ experience in testing/evaluation of agricultural machinery, or 2 years’ teaching/training experience in operation/maintenance of tractors and agricultural implements. Age limit: 33 years (OBC).

2. Medical Officer/Research Officer (Unani)

Qualification: Degree in Unani Medicine from a recognized university/board recognized under the Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970, with enrolment on the Central/State Register of Indian Medicine. Age limit: 35 years (UR/EWS), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC).

3–7. Scientist ‘B’ (Botany/Environmental Science/Geology/Physics/Zoology)

Qualification: Master’s Degree in the respective discipline from a recognized university, with 3 years’ research experience after acquiring the essential qualification. PhD and lab experience in conservation/non-destructive testing are desirable. Age limit: 35 years (UR), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC).

8. Civilian Medical Officer

Qualification: Recognized MBBS degree with completion of compulsory rotating internship. Post-graduate medical qualification is desirable. Age limit: 35 years (UR/EWS), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC/ST).

9. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Immuno-Haematology and Blood Transfusion)

Qualification: MBBS with a postgraduate degree/diploma (MD/DNB) in Immunology, Immuno-Haematology and Blood Transfusion, Pathology, Bacteriology or Haematology with relevant special training, plus at least 3 years’ teaching experience as Senior Resident/Tutor/Registrar/Assistant Professor. Age limit: 40 years (UR), 43 years (OBC).

10. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Surgical Oncology)

Qualification: MBBS with a postgraduate degree/diploma in Surgical Oncology or General Surgery/ENT/Orthopaedics/Obst. & Gynae with special training in Surgical Oncology, plus at least 3 years’ teaching experience. Age limit: 43 years (OBC).

11. Assistant Industrial Adviser

Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Chemical/Metallurgical/Electronics & Communication Engineering, with 3 years’ experience in steel works/rolling mills/plant machinery manufacturing or in iron & steel production, planning, development and research. Age limit: 35 years (UR).

12. Veterinary Assistant Surgeon

Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry/Veterinary Science, registered with the Veterinary Council of India or a State/UT Veterinary Council. Knowledge of Tamil, Malayalam or Telugu is an advantage. Age limit: 35 years (UR), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC).

Note: Age relaxation of up to 10 years is available for PwBD candidates, up to 5 years for SC/ST and up to 3 years for OBC as applicable, and other relaxations for Ex-Servicemen and Central/UT Government employees apply as per UPSC rules.

The upper age limit varies by post and category, ranging from 33 to 43 years as on the closing date for submission of the online application (the crucial date for determining age limit). Age relaxation of up to 10 years is available for PwBD candidates for posts identified as suitable or reserved for them.

UPSC Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

Selection to these posts is made through Recruitment Test (RT), wherever applicable, followed by an Interview, or by Interview alone. The minimum level of suitability in the interview is 50 marks for UR, 45 marks for OBC, and 40 marks for SC/ST/PwBD candidates out of 100 total marks. Candidates must meet the minimum suitability criteria at both the RT and Interview stages, wherever an RT is conducted.

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has invited online recruitment applications under Special Advertisement No. 51/2026 for a total of 828 vacancies, comprising 124 posts of Principal and 704 posts of Vice Principal in the Education Department, Government of NCT of Delhi. Eligible candidates can apply online from 25 July 2026 to 14 August 2026 (up to 6 PM) through the official website https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/.

Candidates must hold a Master's Degree along with a Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) from a recognized university/institute, plus relevant teaching experience - 10 years for Principal and 2 years (as PGT) or 3 years (as TGT) for Vice Principal. Selection will be through a Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) followed by an Interview, weighted 75:25. Principal posts carry Pay Level-12 and Vice Principal posts carry Pay Level-10 as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. The age limit varies by post and category, with relaxation available for reserved categories and PwBD candidates. The job location is New Delhi.

Candidates are advised to pay the application fee of Rs. 25/- (where applicable), fill in all particulars carefully, and submit their application well before the closing date of 14 August 2026 to avoid last-minute issues. Full details on eligibility, fee, and how to apply are provided below.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through a Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) to shortlist candidates for interview, followed by a Personality Test/Interview. Key details:

  • CRT will be held on 01 November 2026 at 15 designated centres.
  • The test is of 2 hours' duration, objective type (MCQs), available in English and Hindi, carrying a maximum of 300 marks.
  • There is negative marking: one-third of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Weightage of CRT and Interview marks is 75:25 for determining final merit.
  • Minimum suitability standard in interview: General/EWS – 50 marks, OBC – 45 marks, SC/ST/PwBD – 40 marks (out of 100).

CRT Syllabus

  • General Knowledge including contemporary social, economic and cultural issues
  • Hindi and English language skills
  • Reasoning ability and Quantitative Aptitude
  • Educational policies & educational measurement and evaluation
  • Management and Financial administration
  • Office Procedure
  • Pedagogy in Education
  • Digital Literacy

CRT Centres

Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi, and Visakhapatnam.

How to Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online from 25 July 2026 to 14 August 2026 (up to 1800 Hrs) through https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/. The process involves four modules:

  1. Account creation
  2. Universal Registration (generates a Universal Registration Number – URN)
  3. Common Application Form (CAF)
  4. Post/Vacancy-specific module (to be filled within the notified time period)

Candidates must upload a photograph, capture a live photo, and upload their signature (signed thrice on plain white paper) as part of the CAF. Applications, once submitted, cannot be withdrawn or edited. Candidates are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card for ID verification and to apply well in advance of the closing date.

Documents Required

  • Matriculation/10th certificate or equivalent (proof of date of birth)
  • Degree/Diploma certificate (Master's Degree, B.Ed)
  • Experience certificate(s) in prescribed proforma from Head(s) of Organisation/Department
  • Caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates) in prescribed proforma
  • OBC non-creamy layer declaration (for OBC candidates)
  • Certificate of Disability in prescribed proforma (for PwBD candidates)
  • Documents for change of name, if applicable
  • Age relaxation certificates (Ex-Servicemen, Government employees, PwBD, etc.), if applicable

Note: Documents like Pay Slip, Resume, Appointment Letter, Relieving Letter, or unsigned Experience Certificates must NOT be uploaded.

Important Instructions

  • Reservation under OBC category applies only to candidates with OBC certificates issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi; certificates from other States/UTs will be treated as General/Unreserved.
  • The closing date for submission of the online application is the date for determining eligibility in every respect.
  • Candidates already in regular Government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department of their application.
  • Candidates must provide a valid, active email ID, as all correspondence will be made through email only.
  • No printouts or documents are to be sent to the Commission by post; they must be brought to the interview if shortlisted.
  • Mobile phones and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall.
  • Face authentication is mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue/interview hall.
  • Furnishing false information or suppressing material facts may lead to rejection, debarment, and disciplinary/criminal action.

Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC) Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 10th August 2026 on the official website www.hsfc.gov.in. A total of 6 vacancies have been announced through the HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026 for various disciplines including Bioinstrumentation, Biophysics, Medical Physics, Biotechnology, Cellular & Molecular Biology, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics and Biomedical Engineering.

Candidates up to 35 years of age who have the required Ph.D. along with the prescribed Master's/Bachelor's qualification are eligible to apply for these Scientist/Engineer SD vacancies. The online application process for HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026 will start on 10th August 2026 and will remain open until 30th August 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Selected candidates will be appointed in Level-11 of the Pay Matrix with a salary of Rs. 67,700 – Rs. 2,08,700 per month, along with admissible allowances and other benefits. Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

HSFC Scientist/Engineer SD Recruitment 2026 Overview

Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC), Bengaluru was formed within ISRO to lead the Human Space Flight Programme. HSFC is inviting online applications for direct recruitment to Scientist/Engineer 'SD' posts in Level-11 of the Pay Matrix, vide Advertisement No. HSFC:01:RMT:2026 dated 10.08.2026.

Post Scientist/Engineer 'SD' (Group 'A')
Pay Level Level-11 of Pay Matrix
Total Posts 6 (Post Codes 01 to 06)
Nature of Post Temporary, but likely to continue
Application Mode Online via ISRO Live Register portal
Official Website www.hsfc.gov.in / careers.hsfc.gov.in

Event Date
Opening date for online registration and application 10.08.2026 (1000 hrs)
Closing date for online registration, application submission and printing of summary 30.08.2026 (1700 hrs)
Crucial date of eligibility (for qualification, age, etc.) 30.08.2026

Candidates who register on ISRO's Live Register portal before 10.08.2026 or after 30.08.2026 will not be considered.
